plan.notes: Source: official Canisius University 2025-2026 undergraduate catalog (Acalog), Computer Science (BS) page, PDF archived at https://catalog.canisius.edu/archive/2025-2026/undergraduate/division-business-communication-health-studies/school-data-computing-mathematics/computer-science/computer-science.pdf ; transcribed manually from the PDF 2026-09-30 into ~/workspace/degree-wave2-work/d2-canisius/. Catalog year 2025-2026: confirmed by archive path and in-PDF links; TRUE degree name is 'Computer Science (BS)'. Catalog degree minimum is 120 credit hours ('more but not less than 120 credit hours'). The published roadmap is titled 'Recommended Semester Schedule for Major Course Requirements' and lists major/track courses only; the Canisius Core Curriculum and free electives needed to reach 120 are modeled as student-choice slots (GENED-1..17, 3 cr each); the exact Core-vs-free-elective split is left to the student and advisor. Science track modeled (MAT 112 + MAT 141 + one 8-credit biology/chemistry/physics sequence = 16 track credits); interdisciplinary-track alternative (approved major/minor in another department) documented in each track slot's choice note. Roadmap shows 'CSC elective, if needed' in BOTH senior terms because 300-level courses rotate every two years; the catalog requires only ONE 300/400-level elective (3-4 cr), modeled once in Fall Year 4 at 3 cr. Roadmap's senior-spring 'Track course, if needed' is not needed for the science track (16 track credits complete by junior spring) and is shown as Core/free-elective space; interdisciplinary-track students use it for minor/major courses. Prereqs are the catalog's stated prerequisites (minimum grade of C where stated); labs list their catalog prerequisites only (corequisites with the lecture are not encoded as prereqs). No 0-credit required courses (CSC 480 Research Experience is optional and omitted). CAVEAT: the canisius.edu program page (as of 2026-09-30) shows a revised curriculum (no CSC 380 requirement, CSC 310 at 3 cr without lab, two electives 6-8 cr) that does NOT match the official 2025-2026 Acalog catalog; this plan follows the catalog of record.

CSC 497 Internship cannot count.
